name: I2I-Bench
description: I2I-Bench is an image-to-image (I2I) evaluation suite that measures the fidelity, fidelity-to-condition, and perceptual quality of conditional image generation / editing models. It provides paired inputs, target outputs, and automated metrics and/or human-evaluation protocols to quantify how well models perform image translation, editing, or guided synthesis tasks.
evaluation_method: FID / LPIPS / CLIP score (automated) and human_eval (perceptual quality)
general_score_metric: FID (with supplementary LPIPS and CLIP alignment scores)
reputation: A niche but useful benchmarking resource for the image-to-image generation community, used for automated and human evaluations of diffusion and conditional generative models.
